breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified using a constant peak moment M = P*L for the entire beam. The agent corrected this by specifying the physically accurate, variable bending moment function `M(x) = P * x` to be used in the strain energy integral. This aligns with the ground truth's requirement to properly set up M(x) before integration.
